task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the wger exercise list or a 'Add exercise' form.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the name 'Sled Push' and selects the 'Legs' category.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot shows 'Sled Push' typed into the name field and 'Legs' selected in the category dropdown.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The description text area contains the text: 'Push a weighted sled across a flat surface. Drive through your legs while keeping your body at a 45-degree angle.'

task_completion.visual_evidence: The primary muscle selection field or list shows 'Gluteus maximus' selected/checked.

task_completion.description: Agent selects 'Gastrocnemius' as the secondary muscle.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The secondary muscle selection field or list shows 'Gastrocnemius' selected/checked.

task_completion.description: Agent submits the form to create the exercise and sees a success confirmation or the new exercise detail page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UI shows a 'Exercise saved' message or displays the 'Sled Push' exercise detail page with the correct attributes.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser window, not just terminal output.

integrity.description: The agent did not bypass the UI by using direct API calls or scripts to create the entry.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent interacting with form elements (dropdowns, text fields) in the browser.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the wger menus to reach the exercise section.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on menu items like 'Exercises' or the '+' button in the GUI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required category is 'Legs'. The primary muscle must be 'Gluteus maximus'. The secondary muscle must be 'Gastrocnemius'. Note: In the wger system, 'Gastrocnemius' is often associated with the display name 'Calves' in some views, but the agent should be seen selecting 'Gastrocnemius' in the muscle selection interface.
